firstEdit.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit.
Edit target: IMAGE 1, the portrait of the man.
Supporting references: IMAGE 2 is the close-up approved CYMBA hardware design, and IMAGE 3 is the CURRENT website hero showing the exact earbuds and finishes. These are PRODUCT references only; do not copy their image composition or scale.

Primary request: remake the portrait as a believable, lightly retouched studio PHOTOGRAPH of this SAME man, against a neutral medium-light studio-grey background, wearing an accurately matched CYMBA wired earbud. The original has an obviously synthetic etched skin texture, artificially traced beard and plastic highlights. Remove those artifacts decisively.

PRESERVE the man's recognisable facial identity, age, warm brown skin tone, nose and lips, short coiled hair, short beard, three-quarter right-facing profile, gently lifted chin, upward-right gaze, serious neutral closed-mouth expression, black knit crewneck, visible left ear and general head-and-shoulders composition. No smile or change of person. Keep the square-compatible portrait framing with full face and earbud safely inside the central frame.

PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM:
Replace the entire artificial surface treatment with natural human skin: subtle irregular pores that vary by region, soft colour variation, realistic transition around eyelids and lips, small natural imperfections. Eliminate the original fingerprint/maze/crosshatch patterns across forehead and cheeks, uniformly sharpened pore noise, oily bronze plastic highlights, and painted or etched outlines around beard hairs. Facial hair should be naturally uneven individual strands, with normal variation in density and softness. Hair should have irregular small coiled strands, not repeated sculpted texture. Keep skin detail restrained, do not blur it smooth or give it beauty-filter skin. Authentic human photographic appearance, moderate optical sharpness and natural tonal transitions; not hyperreal CGI, HDR or illustration. No exaggerated retouching. Preserve identity, but do NOT preserve the fake source skin pattern.
Use soft studio light from a large softbox high at camera right/front with a subtle fill, believable catchlight, natural diffuse skin reflectance and soft shadows. Real 85mm portrait-photo perspective, no over-sharpening.

BACKGROUND:
Replace black backdrop entirely with a seamless NEUTRAL STUDIO GREY around #b5b5b3. A subtle photographic falloff is fine, but it must read clearly as mid-light grey, not black, charcoal, warm beige or a spotlight halo. The background is fully opaque. Keep clean, believable hair edges without a cutout fringe. Lighting should integrate the subject naturally with the lighter backdrop.

EARBUD REDESIGN:
Replace the existing generic brushed-silver disc earbud with the precise CYMBA device shown in images 2 and 3.
- Compact smoked translucent dark body, subtle visible depth.
- Circular matte/satin graphite BLACK faceplate, not bright brushed silver, no sunburst radial grain. Narrow muted champagne metal perimeter.
- Plain curved soft black silicone retention wing tucked naturally into the upper concha, not floating and not hooked outside the ear.
- Silicone tip sits inside the ear canal, correctly occluded; no long nozzle sticking through skin.
- Inner gold contacts and sensor face the skin and are mostly occluded in a worn view. NO invented gold pad on outer wing, no outside LEDs.
- Fine BLACK BRAIDED cable exits downward from a short integrated strain relief and follows the neck/chest naturally. One continuous cable, no second cable or wireless stem.
Believable small worn scale: faceplate roughly 14-16mm, complete bud including wing smaller than the outer ear. Do not enlarge it into a product hero. Render correct occlusion and soft contact shadows where device meets ear, with the same light as the face.

Output: one finished high-quality photographic portrait, 4:5 portrait proportions, comfortably usable with the website's square crop. No text, logos, watermark, border, graphical overlay, or transparency.
firstEdit.reason: Improved background/hardware but retained unnatural etched skin texture.

selectedFreshPortrait.prompt:
Create a believable, understated professional STUDIO PORTRAIT photograph for a consumer technology website. The attached image is ONLY the EARPHONE HARDWARE reference; do not imitate the surface rendering or CGI style of that image. This output must look like an ordinary high-quality camera photograph of a real human, lightly processed, with soft fine detail, not a 3D render, painting, or hyper-detailed AI image.

SUBJECT AND COMPOSITION:
A Black man in his early-to-mid thirties, warm medium-dark brown skin, a dense short rounded natural afro with subtly tapered temples, oval face with pronounced cheekbones, strong rounded jaw and chin, broad straight nose and full lips. Short natural beard, denser on the jaw and chin, a connected moustache. Brown eyes. He wears a plain black textured knitted crewneck sweater. Thoughtful, serious, quietly optimistic expression. Three-quarter profile looking to the right, gaze slightly upwards, left ear clearly visible. Head and shoulders portrait with body toward camera; camera at eye level. Main face in right half, visible ear in left half. Hair fully in frame with a little room above, both shoulders at bottom. Portrait 4:5 composition, suitable to crop to a square without cutting off chin, top of hair, or earbud. The goal is a natural editorial portrait with normal imperfect human skin and an unforced expression.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE:
Shot with a portrait lens around 85mm, f/5.6. Simple medium-light neutral grey seamless studio paper backdrop, gently lit (#b4b4b1). Large diffused softbox at camera left, subtle fill from right. Neutral white balance, modest restrained contrast, gentle highlights with smooth rolloff. Skin should look mostly smooth at portrait viewing size, with sparse tiny subtle pores, tonal variation and natural small marks. Facial hair should read as soft ordinary short beard/stubble, with only a few individual hairs visible. Hair reads in soft masses of curls. Eyes have a small natural single catchlight. Real photographic lens rendering and slight fine camera grain, no extreme clarity or sharpened edges. No retouch-glow, no beauty smoothing, no illustration outline, no synthetic embossed textures, no repetitive loops, no maze or topographical patterns on skin, no glitter, no HDR/metallic skin. Do not use the phrase hyperrealism as a visual style: make it a normal photograph.

EARPHONE:
He wears ONE small wired CYMBA earphone in the visible left ear, exactly based on the OUTSIDE-facing earphone on the LEFT of the attached hardware image. Compact smoked translucent dark shell, a black MATTE subtly textured rounded circular/oval outer faceplate surrounded by a thin muted champagne-metal edge; black short curved stabilizing fin sitting within the upper concha. Size plausible, approximately 18–20mm outer face across, seated naturally, attached to ear with real tiny soft contact shadows. A small black strain relief points downward and a thin black BRAIDED cable descends toward the sweater. The cable braid is subtle at portrait scale. Silicone tip goes inside the canal and is not sticking out. Hardware inner gold contacts and green sensor window are hidden against skin; do not put gold dots on the outer fin. Faceplate is black, not silver, no radial brushed metal disk. No added text, logos, glow or second device. The earphone should follow the same realistic lighting and optical softness as the rest of the photograph.

OUTPUT:
One finished image, no caption, text, border or collage. This should pass as a natural studio portrait at normal web viewing size, with understated photographic imperfections.
